summary: Stream complete agents rosters with opt-in revision-fenced snapshots and whole-row deltas

replay.detail: Only the latest publication is available. Reconnect and replacement start from complete snapshots; no replay log is introduced.

schema.detail: No database or claim schemas change. The client wire contract adds agents publication metadata, snapshot chunks and whole-row deltas.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Legacy HTTP, exact agent selectors and bounded collection subscriptions remain unchanged. Granted collections.agents.revisioned.v1 clients can subscribe with agents_publication_version:1 and no filters or limit. Fractal feed opts in only when granted and atomically assembles complete agents snapshots. Frames are bounded to 1 MiB; oversized whole rows are permanently refused. Publication notices coalesce over a non-sliding 50 ms window; contiguous sequences revalidate authority and have an eight-second total send deadline.

downtime.detail: Normal binary upgrade restart only; the publication epoch changes on restart.

manual.detail: No configuration or state migration is required.

recovery.detail: Reconnect obtains the latest complete roster. Oversized-row refusals retain the agents-publication-row-too-large code through client error normalization. Returning to an older binary needs no database rollback; clients negotiate the legacy window.
